record.text:
cobweb as multiplication. two passes:

first — the diagonal y=x as golden reference, everything measures distance from it. second — the cobweb as chain of varying multipliers. the record of multiplication changing its mind.

the eigen-arc multiplies; the cobweb visualizes the chain.

images.alt: a mathematical cobweb diagram converging on an absent center with the diagonal y=x rendered as a golden thread
a cobweb spiral in amber and cream, accumulation of distance from the diagonal
